name: POP-05 daily unrest stop/loss and rollback setup

data.sql: DELETE FROM planets WHERE name IN ('v3_pop05_daily_qa','v3_pop05_rollback_qa');
INSERT INTO planettypes(code,typeName,typeDescription) VALUES ('V3_POP05_QA','POP-05 QA','Disposable acceptance type');

tests.name: Create daily slave planet with conserved population assignments

data.sql: INSERT INTO planets(sector_id,name,owner_id,owner_type,class,population,population_type,type,created_by,colonists_unassigned,colonists_ore,colonists_org,colonists_eq,colonists_weapons,slave_unrest_next_at,slave_unrest_stopped,slave_unrest_stoppage_until) SELECT 1,'v3_pop05_daily_qa',player_id,'player','M',20,'SLAVE',pt.planettypes_id,player_id,0,10,5,3,2,EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW())::bigint-1,FALSE,NULL FROM players CROSS JOIN planettypes pt WHERE players.name='System' AND pt.code='V3_POP05_QA';

tests.name: Create rollback slave planet with future event time

data.sql: INSERT INTO planets(sector_id,name,owner_id,owner_type,class,population,population_type,type,created_by,colonists_unassigned,colonists_ore,colonists_org,colonists_eq,colonists_weapons,slave_unrest_next_at,slave_unrest_stopped,slave_unrest_stoppage_until) SELECT 1,'v3_pop05_rollback_qa',player_id,'player','M',20,'SLAVE',pt.planettypes_id,player_id,0,10,5,3,2,EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW())::bigint+3600,FALSE,NULL FROM players CROSS JOIN planettypes pt WHERE players.name='System' AND pt.code='V3_POP05_QA';

tests.name: Run the authoritative daily unrest handler concurrently from two authenticated sessions
Verify exact loss, proportional assignments, persistent stoppage and unchanged ownership/population class

data.sql: SELECT (SELECT population=16 AND colonists_ore=8 AND colonists_org=4 AND colonists_eq=2 AND colonists_weapons=2 AND slave_unrest_stopped AND slave_unrest_stoppage_until>EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW())::bigint FROM planets WHERE name='v3_pop05_daily_qa')::int,(SELECT COUNT(*)=1 AND MAX(applied_population_loss)=4 FROM planet_slave_unrest_events e JOIN planets p USING(planet_id) WHERE p.name='v3_pop05_daily_qa')::int,(SELECT population=20 AND slave_unrest_next_at>EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW())::bigint FROM planets WHERE name='v3_pop05_rollback_qa')::int,(SELECT owner_type='player' AND population_type='SLAVE' FROM planets WHERE name='v3_pop05_daily_qa')::int;

tests.name: Replay the daily handler without duplicate loss
Assert replay leaves one event and exact population

data.sql: SELECT (SELECT population=16 FROM planets WHERE name='v3_pop05_daily_qa')::int,(SELECT COUNT(*)=1 FROM planet_slave_unrest_events e JOIN planets p USING(planet_id) WHERE p.name='v3_pop05_daily_qa')::int;
UPDATE planets SET slave_unrest_next_at=EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW())::bigint-1 WHERE name='v3_pop05_rollback_qa';

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION v3_pop05_inject_failure() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN IF NEW.planet_id=(SELECT planet_id FROM planets WHERE name='v3_pop05_rollback_qa') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'controlled POP-05 rollback'; END IF; RETURN NEW; END $$;

tests.name: Install controlled fault after transaction begins

data.sql: CREATE TRIGGER v3_pop05_fault BEFORE INSERT ON planet_slave_unrest_events FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION v3_pop05_inject_failure();

tests.name: Verify rollback preserves due time, population and events

data.sql: SELECT (SELECT population=20 AND slave_unrest_next_at<EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW())::bigint FROM planets WHERE name='v3_pop05_rollback_qa')::int,(SELECT COUNT(*)=0 FROM planet_slave_unrest_events e JOIN planets p USING(planet_id) WHERE p.name='v3_pop05_rollback_qa')::int;
